World Cup Coverage Highlights Matches, Fan Experience, and Player Stories

Multiple Indian media outlets covered various aspects of the FIFA World Cup 2026 and the T20 World Cup. Reports detailed match outcomes, including Morocco's victory over the Netherlands and Brazil's win against Japan. Fan engagement was highlighted with fan parks planned in Assam and Hyderabad, while player journeys and team selections also featured.
